validation.normalization: Each 1254x1254 output was center-cropped by one pixel per edge to 1252x1252, giving exact 313x313 cells while preserving the 4x4 layout.
validation.alpha_cleanup: Removed only exact pure-red RGB (255,0,0) pixels with alpha 1-2; removed counts: air combat 9525, ground combat 13442, locomotion 10602, mobility 10500. Warm opaque pixels were preserved.
validation.reason: All four sheets were visually inspected after cleanup: no remaining exact pure-red alpha 1-2 pixels, true alpha remains, the 4x4 layout is 313x313 per cell, and character identity, outfit, backpack, and flat marked wooden ruler are consistent. The air-combat edit corrected the duplicated plunge pose and anomalous splash.
validation.foot_offsets: Per-frame, per-sheet vertical pixel corrections applied on top of the safe_cuts grid margin so every frame's measured opaque bottom (feet/shoe) lands on the same canvas row (413, derived from AnimatedSprite2D.offset.y=-157 on a 512-tall virtual canvas), preventing feet jitter across non-uniformly cut cells. Computed by cropping each frame with safe_cuts, measuring its opaque alpha bounding box, and solving offset = 413 - measured_bottom_row. See scripts/player/luz_animation_catalog.gd:_frame_margin.
validation.frame_overrides: luz_mobility_sheet.png frames 2/3 (ground_dash) needed an explicit rectangle instead of the safe_cuts grid: the generated art's frame-3 ruler tip genuinely starts at x=939, 25px inside frame 2's grid cell, so the shared vertical safe_cut at x=964 bled a disconnected ruler-tip fragment into frame 2. The override reassigns that 25px strip to frame 3 (its rightful owner) and trims frame 2 at x=938. luz_locomotion_sheet.png frame 13 (crouch, second frame) had a small (~27x13px) disconnected shoe-tip fragment bled down from the jump_ascent/fall row above through the shared horizontal safe_cut at y=966; its override trims the top 73px (to y0=1039), which is well clear of the crouch pose itself (its body starts at y=1039 in this cell).
